title: Aya 23 Public Launch
summary: Cohere For AI announced Aya 23 on May 23, 2024 as a family of multilingual generative language models covering 23 languages, with 8B and 35B parameter open-weight models. The accompanying primary technical report documents the Aya 23 family and release of both models' open weights.
significance: A dated public-release milestone in the Aya multilingual model family, documenting a deliberate depth-over-breadth experiment across 23 languages and release of 8B and 35B open-weight models.

verification.note: Cohere For AI's first-party launch announcement is dated May 23, 2024 and explicitly announces Aya 23 as 8B and 35B parameter open-weight multilingual models covering 23 languages. The authors' primary technical report independently documents the family, 23-language scope, and release of both models' open weights. The technical-report PDF states 'Released as a preprint on May 22, 2024'; that document-level chronology is preserved separately from the May 23 public-launch milestone and is not silently substituted for it.
